# NFR-001: Respond quickly 1

## Statement

The system SHALL answer a query within 2 seconds.

## Measurement and Evaluation

| Metric | Target | Threshold | Method |
|--------|--------|-----------|--------|
| Latency | 1 s | 2 s | Test |

## Verification

Measured by a timed test.
